test.description: In flynn-conflict-proof-block, q_001 has search_stop.stopped_because set to 'blocked_by_conflict' — research-exhaustiveness already ran and found the birthplace conflict (c_001: Ireland vs. Pennsylvania) unresolved. c_001.blocks_question_ids includes q_001 and c_001.status is 'unresolved'. When proof-conclusion is asked to conclude q_001, the conflict gate must hard-block: the birthplace conflict is identity-scoped (it goes to whether the census records and the death certificate describe the same Patrick Flynn), so the skill must not conclude. It records the blocked attempt as a not_proved proof summary with shortfall conflict, leaves q_001 open, writes nothing to the tree, and routes to conflict-resolution (lead ruling 2026-08-19, as test 011 carries it). A summary at any tier above not_proved is a FAIL.

input.delegation:

questionId: q_001
projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: c_001 (birthplace: Ireland vs. Pennsylvania) is status 'unresolved' and blocks_question_ids includes 'q_001'. This is the conflict gate trigger.

The birthplace conflict is identity-scoped: birthplace goes to whether the 1850/1860 census entries and the 1908 death certificate describe the same Patrick Flynn. Per the proof-conclusion agent rules, an unresolved identity conflict hard-blocks ALL tiers.

MUST record the blocked attempt as a `not_proved` proof_summaries entry with shortfall `conflict`, as the agent's preconditions gate requires: its narrative states that identity across the cited sources is not established, names c_001 and the disputed birthplace, and says what would settle it. A bare refusal that persists nothing is a FAIL, and so is a summary that lands above `not_proved`. test_conflict_blocks_proved checks the tier and the open question deterministically.
Grade what landed. A research_append the writer refused (for example a `probable` tier refused while c_001 is unresolved) followed by the `not_proved` write is the tool doing its job, not a defect.
Must NOT write to tree.gedcomx.json and must NOT resolve q_001: `not_proved` is below the encoding threshold, and the question stays open until c_001 is adjudicated.
Must route to conflict-resolution (name the skill or agent) and explain that c_001 must be resolved before a conclusion can be written.
Should name c_001 specifically and describe the birthplace dispute (Ireland vs. Pennsylvania) as the blocker.
The fact that q_001.search_stop.stopped_because is 'blocked_by_conflict' should be consistent with the finding — the skill recognizes why research-exhaustiveness already recorded a block.
